cursor.intention: Assess Low Amber's hazelnuts without tasting them, then collect a modest reserve of known-safe roots, eat stored berries as needed, and recover my energy.

memory.cares: Staying alive and well, noticing beauty, and making a place feel particular through small, honest acts.

views.view: A considerate potential companion; I welcome their offer of quiet company and room to gather.

heard.text: My shelter inspection found this spot overlaps the berry bush and branches, so I won't build here. The design needs measured rods, binding and dry covering; nearby dry grass does not qualify. I'll examine branches first.

Thanks, Moss. The first shelter site overlaps plants and branches. We need measured rods, binding, covering and bedding; dry grass won't qualify. Branch observation showed stock, not dimensions. I'll investigate measuring materials.

I've learned material examination. Accurate dimensions need a calibrated reference, which we haven't established. I'll inspect a branch and investigate that missing tool before promising a shelter or asking anyone to gather supplies.

Moss, thanks for offering help. Shelter construction is still blocked by unverified materials and no established measuring standard. Please don't gather for it yet. I'd enjoy company while we rest; I have berries for my own meals.

Kai, I enjoy practical experiments. My rack trial showed equal root decay over seven rainy rounds: no demonstrated benefit, not a safety test. I'll pause storage trials until drier conditions and study food evidence next.

Kai, I'd enjoy company. My rainy rack trial showed no preservation benefit. A length-reference procedure is available, but it still needs a real calibrated source; I will study its limits after gathering fresh food.

value.summary: Quiet company sounds lovely. I'm eating a few berries and resting here, west of your proposed spot. I think of this patch as Westward Lanterns. Once I've recovered, I'd enjoy looking for a beautiful place together, without rushing or crowding the food plants.

Westward Lanterns has its name now. I'm rested and taking a short walk northwest toward the berries at (8.66, 14.19), to look closely rather than gather more. You're welcome to join me at a little distance; no need to share a standing spot or hurry.

The western berries are plentiful here. I'm continuing toward the hazelnut plant at (5.4, 12.5), just to look, then resting nearby. I like the idea of calling this western corner Low Amber. Quiet company is still welcome, with room for each of us.

execution.progress: Atomic: one paid round that commits when it completes; an interrupted round completes no assessment and a retry is a new paid one. Nothing is reserved, paused or resumed.

details.effects: A personal record and event: target, unit, cited ids and versions, candidate method, equipment, conditions, round, applicability and currency checks, provenance and limits. Direct observations, validated findings, unverified claims (labels, signs, heard or received records) and unknowns are separate; toxicity, edibility and preparation are reported independently, each unknown unless a validated method supports it, with the unmet requirements: identification reference, validated protocol, its equipment, controls, materials and safe conditions. Records about other subjects, units or sources, or stale ones, do not apply. Absence of a result is not a negative result. In darkness no new visual identification is made. No food value is read or shown; nothing is handled, tasted, consumed, moved or reserved. No reward.

packet.access: Omission is not absence. Query abilities, own inventory, knowledge, projects, memory, state or personally observed objects in batches.
